# The Memory Merchant

In the depths of the market, where shadows became tangibles...

A figure... emerged. Known... only as the Memory... Merchant.

He carried boxes made of forgotten... moments.

Each... box contained... a memory from another...

The buyer would open the box and experience... the memory... firsthand.

But there... was a catch...

The memory would change the buyer...

In unexpected...

*scrambled thoughts*... Ah, the the *clears*...

The memory would alter... the buyer's perception...

of reality...

of themselves...

of the world...

*pauses*...

The Memory Merchant... was said... to possess... the ability...

to curate... the most precious memories

and sell them...

to those... willing to pay the price...

*trails off*...
